body: Engineering check, 14 Nov 2026: emulator, build 151, account qaowner, against VM 108 at sha-35a086e; NOT the release-candidate pair. Downloaded two songs the server already keeps (In Da Club, Candy Shop; opus160, about 4.1 MB each; no YouTube look-up for either). Airplane mode ON and a DIFFERENT song current (In Da Club, paused): one tap on the downloaded row of Candy Shop in the '00s Hip Hop playlist started it. Proof it was audible and not only a button that flipped: the full player showed 'Playing from 00s Hip Hop' and the elapsed time ran with the clock in airplane mode (about 4 minutes later it read 4:07 of 4:09), and the phone's audio service listed the app's AudioTrack as 'started'. Not counted as proof: an earlier tap on In Da Club after a force-stop and a cold start in airplane mode (it was the restored current song and was judged from the mini player). Not covered: a list whose first song is NOT downloaded (the Play button still pays one reach look), the A35, the release-candidate pair.
